verdict.rationale: Check is a hosted payroll API and embedded-components SaaS, so self-hosting the core product is a fair question to ask, but the evidence shows no way to run the payroll, tax and money-movement platform on your own infrastructure. The only self-hosted piece is the Check MCP Server, an adjacent client-side integration that still calls Check's hosted API, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Run the Check MCP Server locally for full control over your configuration, access control, and environment.
